rationale: A literature check identified path and subgraph models, graph transformers, text-LLM fusion, multimodal contrastive methods, pre-training and hyper-relational models as the current families. The proposed order for Pharos was a path model (NBFNet or BioPathNet) first, then Simple-HGN or HGT, then text-graph features, then self-supervised pre-training, all scored on the existing honest protocols rather than the committed gate.
subject: P-15
title: Next model directions from the 2025-2026 link-prediction literature
